verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation, such as rules or callbacks fired on indexing or task events, is a fair question for a search engine. However, the pack documents no rule engine that triggers actions on events. 'Dynamic Search Rules' (boost/pin/bury per request) and tenant-token filters are query-time relevance and access controls, not event-driven actions. Meilisync and the Rails/Firebase auto-sync are separate data-sync integrations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
